risk_summary: The disclosure presents significant liquidity and going-concern risk, including persistent losses, substantial additional funding needs, and no assurance that financing will be available on acceptable terms. Clinical enrollment difficulties, regulatory uncertainty, COVID-19 effects, and limited revenue further elevate execution risk, although the filing provides meaningful quantitative detail on cash, expenses, and losses.
